tasks.title: Announcement #61
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement at a university club meeting.
tasks.transcript: Welcome everyone. Today I'm pleased to announce that our club has arranged a guest speaker for next week's meeting. Dr. Rivera will be discussing the impacts of climate change on ocean ecosystems. The lecture will be held in room 105 at 5 p.m. on Tuesday. Please mark your calendars.

questions.stem: What is the main topic of the announcement?

options.B: A change in a meeting schedule

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：这则公告的主要话题是什么？ 定位原文：Today I'm pleased to announce that our club has arranged a guest speaker for next week's meeting. Dr. Rivera will be discussing the impacts of climate change on ocean ecosystems. 选项分析： A. A participation fee 参与费用。公告中未提及费用，所以A选项错误。 B. A change in a meeting schedule 会议时间安排的变更。公告中未提及时间变更，而是宣布新增一个活动，所以B选项错误。 C. A volunteering opportunity 一个志愿服务机会。公告中未提及志愿服务，所以C选项错误。 D. An upcoming guest lecture 一场即将到来的客座讲座。公告明确宣布俱乐部安排了客座演讲人Dr. Rivera来做讲座，所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What are students encouraged to do?
questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：鼓励学生们做什么？ 定位原文：Please mark your calendars. 选项分析： A. Sign up for the lecture 报名参加讲座。公告中未提及需要报名，所以A选项错误。 B. Visit room 105 去105房间。公告中提到讲座在105房间举行，但鼓励的具体内容是标记日历，而不是单纯去那个房间，所以B选项错误。 C. Prepare questions for Dr. Rivera 为Dr. Rivera准备问题。公告中未提及准备问题，所以C选项错误。 D. Mark their calendars 标记他们的日历。说话者明确说“请标记你们的日历”，所以D选项正确。
